description: TIMES MIRO is a GAMS MIRO application for running and comparing IEA-ETSAP TIMES energy-system models. It lets a modeller change assumptions from an existing TIMES case, run sensitivity scenarios and inspect model outputs in tables and charts. Inputs can be packaged TIMES scenarios or supported Excel and dd model files; outputs are optimisation results for the selected system and planning years. Geographic coverage belongs to the imported TIMES case, including the documented demo and Denmark examples. The repository code is free under MIT terms, with installation guidance and releases. Running it locally also needs recent GAMS and GAMS MIRO installations, whose licence and cost are separate from this repository. Excel import additionally uses xl2times, reviewed as its own resource. A limitation is that this interface does not validate model data or make a commercial solver available. It can compare electricity and fuel-system transition scenarios. The related catalogue TIMES Ireland model is a separate national case. No installer, model workbook or solver was downloaded.
